material.head: A deep wave 4
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Oct 13 to Nov 5 (+26%; wave 3 is 2.5 times wave 1). The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−2.9%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.
